Safety & governance

Built for healthcare, from the ground up.

LifeBack™ is designed around healthcare's core security, consent, and oversight requirements from the ground up.

Clinician oversight

AI outputs are reviewable, with clinician review built into the workflow.

Consent & role-based access

Patient, clinician, and institutional access are separated and governed by consent controls.

Traceable AI

Assessment outputs are structured and evidence-backed, never opaque.

Data protection

Handled under India's DPDP Act, 2023, with privacy-by-design architecture.

Regulatory pathway

Developed within India's CDSCO SaMD framework with quality management systems.

Clinical partners

Built with hospitals and clinical KOLs, not in isolation.

Interoperability & regulatory detail

Built on ABDM rails (ABHA, FHIR R4, HIE & Consent Manager) with results written into existing HIS/EMR systems. It operates within the CDSCO SaMD framework, with India data residency by default and cloud hosting designed for healthcare use.
